entities.name: Q6X7K0 WUSCHEL-related homeobox 1
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana WUSCHEL-related homeobox 1; 350 aa; identity and coverage 100%, E-value 3.71e-254.
Contains Pfam Homeodomain PF00046 at residues 75–134.
UniProt annotation describes a transcription factor potentially involved in developmental processes; localized to nucleus.
GO annotations include nucleus, DNA binding, DNA-binding transcription factor activity, plant organ development, and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.
Sequence-derived properties: estimated molecular weight 40,142 Da, pI 6.97, GRAVY -0.960, instability index 55.0; estimates exclude modifications and processing.
